subject: minicode
title: Filesystem jail and bash-guard run BEFORE mode dispatch and bind even in allow-all, with a realpath double-key against internal symlink escape
evidence: src/policy/permission.ts:379-441 (universal jail pre-mode), :483-497 (allow-all still runs full bash-guard), :443-479 (owned-state .minicode/ write lock, string + isOwnedStateReal realpath check); src/policy/jail.ts:44-60
one_why: The usual failure of 'allow-all' is that it becomes unrestricted host access; here the only thing a mode can disable is the approval prompt, never the path jail, the credential denylist, or the guard against a subagent poisoning minicode's own state (fake 'always' allowlist, malicious MCP config, blinded recovery journal) - and the double-key (logical string + resolved real path) closes the junction/symlink-around hole that string-only checks always have.

subject: minicode
title: Bash denylist done right: normalize-then-match (quotes, simple-var inlining with chained rescan, cmd.exe caret escapes) with honest limits stated and paired must-deny/must-allow oracle probes run in PR CI on Linux and Windows
evidence: src/policy/bash-guard.ts:1-19 (bypass classes that motivated it), :38-46 (stripQuotes), :60-88 (quote-aware caret stripping with reasoned PowerShell non-treatment), :90-120 (inlineSimpleVars 3-pass rescan); experiments/bash-bypass-probe.ts:11-13 (each case paired with must-allow over-block guard); .github/workflows/ci.yml:77-83,158-159
one_why: The corpus's standing anti-pattern is regex-over-raw-string denylists trivially bypassed by `cat .e""nv` or `X=.env; cat $X`; minicode closes the whole equivalence class by canonicalizing before matching, refuses to pretend the residual is solved ('static analysis over a Turing-complete language - raises the cost of attack, does not remove it'), and ties every rule to a two-sided probe that runs per PR on two OSes so neither bypasses nor over-blocks regress silently.

subject: minicode
title: Compaction tiering with anti-thrash circuit breaker, verbatim-pinned prior summary, hard summary budget, and compaction spend booked into the session budget
evidence: src/policy/compaction.ts:44-51 (F3.1 per-session thrash state), :95-120 (2 sub-10% rounds disable LLM path, loop falls to sync-mechanical), :207-217 (prior summary pinned verbatim, never re-summarized - anti semantic drift), :169-215 (composeBoundedSummary 1500-char cap, asymmetric trim directions, lone-surrogate drop), :31-40+:293-305 (compaction usage reported to session bus); loop.ts:336-355 (async compactor can never crash the loop); CHANGELOG.md:5-8 (measured 53.9x growth fix)
one_why: Three failure modes every summarize-and-prepend scheme has - unbounded summary growth (window filled by the summary itself), semantic drift from summarizing summaries, and compaction LLM spend invisible to cost accounting - each has an explicit, tested mechanism here, plus a breaker that notices when compaction stops making progress instead of burning a provider call per turn forever.

subject: minicode
title: Seeded-PRNG bash-guard fuzz plus shadow-git stress and adversarial MCP server on nightly CI
evidence: experiments/extreme-bash-fuzz.ts:17-34 (deterministic LCG, bugs reproducible via --seed); .github/workflows/slow.yml:28-34 (multi-seed multi-round nightly), :35-37 (shadow-git 1500 files x 8 sessions), :39-41 (extreme-mcp-adversarial)
one_why: Not coverage-guided fuzzing, but a reproducible adversarial loop against the exact components that carry the security claims, scheduled nightly so PR CI stays fast; the seed-reproducibility contract (found bug -> replay command) is the piece most harness-less repos skip.

subject: minicode
title: Mutation-intent journal answering exactly one question - is mutation X committed? - with intent issued after permission and before execute, finalize only on durable SQLite, and fail-open-with-degraded on journal write failure
evidence: src/session/journal.ts:1-22 (design, explicit non-goals: not a cross FS+DB transaction, never auto-redo, resume = verify-first), :29-40 (record schema with childOf delegation chain); test/journal-verify.test.ts, recovery-idempotency.test.ts, recovery-side-effects.test.ts
one_why: After a crash the honest answer for FS-vs-DB mutation state is 'unknown', and most subjects either ignore it or overclaim transactions; minicode scopes the artifact to commitment truth, deliberately fails OPEN on journal write failure (killing the turn over a log error destroys more than the gap) while flipping the session to an advisory resume path - the tradeoff is written down instead of hidden.

subject: minicode
title: Shadow-git checkpoints: temporary GIT_INDEX_FILE + write-tree pinned under refs/minicode/ as bare trees, undo = tree-diff restore of changed paths only, user index/HEAD provably untouched
evidence: src/session/shadow-git.ts:12-27 (O(delta) object-store approach replacing the old O(workspace) JSON manifest; trees pinned via refs so gc keeps them; invisible to git log --all / git branch); test/shadow-git.test.ts; slow.yml:35-37 (stress)
one_why: Cline's git-stash checkpoints pollute user stash/reflog and cost a full snapshot; this reuses the existing object store for content-addressed delta checkpoints while making a hard promise - no git add/commit/checkout/reset/stash ever touches user state - and records its honest limit (.gitignore'd files are outside the snapshot, stated at :29-30).

subject: minicode
title: Docs-map drift gate: every git-tracked src/** file MUST appear in docs/ARCHITECTURE.html, kernel pin in the map MUST equal VENDOR.md, plus layer-direction import tests
evidence: test/architecture-map.test.ts:1-29 (two drift incidents cited as motivation: untracked motion.ts file, stale kernel pin); test/ui-boundary.test.ts; AGENTS.md:20-24 (import direction rules)
one_why: 'AGENTS.md says update the map' is a prayer; this makes the living architecture document a build artifact under test - a doc that cannot silently rot is a force multiplier for both humans and agents working the repo, and it caught two real drifts before being written as a test.

subject: minicode
title: Two-repo kernel split: 1.6k-LOC agent kernel frozen, vendored into the product via #minicore subpath imports, seams additive-only, sync hash-pinned and CI-checked
evidence: package.json:44-46 (imports #minicore -> vendor/minicore), vendor/minicore/VENDOR.md:5-14 (source commit 0d33571, file hash, shipped-tarball hash, vendor:minicore workflow), .github/workflows/ci.yml:44-46 (vendor:check per PR), AGENTS.md:41 (do-not-edit rule)
one_why: Distinct from vendoring a third-party fork: this is deliberate kernel/product segregation of the team's own runtime - the loop stays small, deterministic, and reviewable (355-LOC loop.ts) while the product layer churns, and the only permitted kernel edits are backward-compatible additive seams (compactAsync/initialMessages/cwd), enforced by hash check rather than discipline; nobody gets to quietly grow the kernel from the product side.

subject: minicode
title: Evidence-gated task completion: `completed` requires injected verify evidence, failed verify demotes the task to a new `blocked` state, no-verify runs report `unverified` instead of claiming verified
evidence: src/tools/todo.ts:51 (setCompletionEvidence injection point), cli/setup.ts:1184 (composition-root wires last verify verdict in), CHANGELOG.md:5-8 (pre-fix state: no code path prevented marking done while verify red)
one_why: Self-reported completion is the agent's favorite lie; rather than blocking normal no-verify usage, the design makes the claim honest at the state level - completed means evidenced, blocked carries the reason to the model, and unverified is visibly distinct from both.

subject: minicode
title: One-page threat model naming the deterministic execution chain (permission -> jail -> guard -> validation -> executor -> journal) with per-mode tables and a 'no absolute safe' rule
evidence: docs/security-model.md:1-30 (every claim points to a readable/testable mechanism; explicit 'allow-all is not unrestricted host access' callout)
one_why: The doc mirrors the actual gate order in code and states what is NOT protected instead of marketing safety; pi's SECURITY.md honesty is the anchor for this rung and minicode matches it with an unusually concrete mode x mechanism table.
